workspaceActions.noGrpcCode: Explains why code snippets cannot be generated for a gRPC call.
workspaceActions.noMcpCode: Explains why code snippets cannot be generated for an MCP tool call.
workspaceActions.codeFailed: Title of an error dialog when code generation is not possible.
workspaceActions.copyName: Name given to a duplicated request, where {{name}} is the original name. Saved as the request name.
workspaceActions.curlFailed: Title of an error dialog. curl is a command line tool; keep the name.
workspaceActions.importComplete: Title of the summary dialog after an import.
workspaceActions.imported: {{counts}} is a phrase such as 3 requests and 1 folder.
workspaceActions.newFolder: Title of the dialog that asks for a folder name.
workspaceActions.newSubfolder: Title of the dialog that asks for the name of a folder inside another folder.
workspaceActions.deleteFolderToTop: {{name}} is a folder name, {{requests}} and {{subfolders}} are counted phrases such as 2 requests. The top level is the root of the collection list.
workspaceActions.deleteFolderToParent: {{name}} is a folder name, {{requests}} and {{subfolders}} are counted phrases, {{parent}} is the name of the folder that contains it.
workspaceActions.clear: Confirm button of the clear history dialog.
workspaceActions.dontSave: Button that closes the tab and drops the changes.
